description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Fit_Line' that performs linear regression fitting and plotting as part of the Image_Graph library, specifically in the Plot/Fit/Line.php subdirectory. The class extends a base plotting class and includes methods for drawing legend samples and rendering the fitted line based on dataset regression calculations.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Fit_Line
classes.description: A class that performs linear regression fitting on datasets and plots the resulting line on a graph.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample line in the legend box to represent the fitted line.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Completes the plotting of the fitted line by calculating regression for each dataset and drawing it.
